arguments.body: Hi Sawyer, thanks for your message. We have no record of the landlord's approval yet, so please don't order the carpet or parts or start work until we confirm in writing. We've asked the landlord to confirm directly and will come back to you as soon as we hear. Please also confirm whether your prices include VAT.
